fallback_result.reasoning: Step (18) is false under the paper's own update rule. The proof asserts: 'Since L^a and L^v are strongly convex, there exists rho in (0,1) satisfying ||Phi(t) - Phi*|| <= rho^t ||Phi(0) - Phi*||.' Two problems. (i) Strong convexity alone does NOT imply linear convergence of iterates: that requires an optimisation algorithm with step-size conditions (and usually smoothness). (ii) Under the paper's update rule (15)-(16) plus the claim at line 530 ('parameters for each modality are independent: L^v(Phi(t+1)) = L^v(Phi(t))'), the video parameter block is frozen, so ||Phi(t)-Phi*||^2 = ||Phi^a(t)-Phi^{*a}||^2 + ||Phi^v(0)-Phi^{*v}||^2 never tends to 0 when Phi^v(0) != Phi^{*v}, contradicting (18). Concrete counterexample satisfying Assumptions 1-5: L^a(x)=x^2, L^v(y)=(y-1)^2, Phi*=(0,1), Phi(0)=(1,0), perfect boosting on the audio block, video frozen. Then ||Phi(t)-Phi*|| >= 1 for all t while rho^t||Phi(0)-Phi*|| -> 0. The rest of the chain ((19)-(27) smoothness/triangle-inequality bounds, (28)-(34) PL-type inequality) is correct conditional on (18), with two further blemishes: (28) uses a constant mu_a while (29) switches to 2mu (mu never defined), and (22)/(30) silently use the unstated assumption L^a(Phi*)=L^v(Phi*).

summary: Verified 13 mathematical snippets from the paper: 6 via Lean 4 (shared project MATH_VERIFICATION/Paper, reused and kept) and 7 via informal review. Lean formally proved the sequence-level rate bound behind Theorem 1 (eq. 8 and eq. 35, PASSED), the algebraic core of Lemma 1 (eqs. 28-34, PASSED), and the reciprocal-summation algebra of Proof of Theorem 1 (eqs. 43-46, PASSED). Two claims were FORMALLY REFUTED: (1) equation (18) — strong convexity does not yield linear convergence of the joint iterates under the paper's own frozen-video update rule; this false step is load-bearing for Lemma 1 and hence Theorem 1; (2) equation (2) — the one-hot masking does not ensure non-negativity of residual labels (a counterexample with two fully-confident previous classifiers and lambda=1 gives -1 at the ground-truth coordinate). An informal review of Proof of Lemma 1 (paper::PROOF::0) independently flags the same (18) flaw plus a mu_a/2mu constant inconsistency and the unstated equal-optimal-value assumption. Both refuted claims are rated minor because the paper explicitly labels Theorem 1 'informal' and hedges the convergence guarantee, and the empirical results are unaffected. All findings are reported at confidence >= 0.7; there are no critical findings. Verdict: MINOR_ERRORS (confident). The report also notes the paper references equations (3), (4) and (5) in the ablation study and Section 3.2 that never appear in the manuscript text — a presentation defect, not a mathematical finding.
